name: EveR
maker: Korea University of Science and Technology
def: Line of female android robots developed by South Korean researchers at the Korea Institute of Industrial Technology and first shown to the public in Seoul in 2003.
facts: Unveiled at the Kyoyuk MunHwa HoeKwan hotel in Seoul on 4 May 2003
Project led by Baek Moon hong
Name joins the biblical Eve with the letter r for robot
